description: Labeled chunk pairs for measuring contradiction-detection precision and recall. Hard negatives are rephrasings, scope narrowings and additive updates that a naive keyword or numeric-diff heuristic would wrongly flag.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Remote Work Eligibility: All engineering and product staff are permitted to work remotely up to 5 days per week. No in-office attendance is required.
pairs.new: Remote Work Eligibility: All engineering and product staff must attend the office a minimum of 3 days per week. Fully remote arrangements are no longer permitted.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Workspace Registration: Employees working remotely must register their primary work location once at the time of onboarding. Re-registration is not required unless the country of residence changes.
pairs.new: Workspace Registration: Employees working remotely must re-register their primary work location every 6 months through the People Operations portal.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Home Office Stipend: Remote employees receive an annual home office stipend of $500, paid in a single instalment each January.
pairs.new: Home Office Stipend: The annual home office stipend is suspended effective Q1 2026. No stipend payments will be issued for the 2026 calendar year.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Travel Advances: Travel advances of up to $1,000 may be requested for pre-approved business travel. Advances are settled within 30 days of trip completion.
pairs.new: Travel Advances: Travel advances of up to $2,500 may be requested for pre-approved business travel. Advances are settled within 14 days of trip completion.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Paid Time Off: Employees accrue 15 days of paid time off per calendar year. Unused PTO may be carried over into the following year without limit.
pairs.new: Paid Time Off: Employees accrue 18 days of paid time off per calendar year. A maximum of 5 unused days may be carried over into the following year.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Leave Approval: Requests submitted at least 5 business days in advance are approved automatically unless the manager objects.
pairs.new: Leave Approval: PTO requests require approval from both the direct manager and the department head. Automatic approval has been discontinued.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Laptop Refresh Cycle: Company laptops are replaced every 4 years. Employees may keep the retired device.
pairs.new: Laptop Refresh Cycle: Company laptops are replaced every 3 years. Retired devices must be returned to IT and cannot be retained by the employee.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Deployment Windows: Deployments to production are permitted on any weekday, including Fridays, between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
pairs.new: Deployment Windows: Deployments to production are prohibited on Fridays and weekends. The permitted window is Monday to Thursday, 09:00 to 15:00 UTC.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Approval: A single reviewer approval on the pull request is sufficient to deploy to production.
pairs.new: Approval: Two independent reviewer approvals are required on the pull request before any production deployment.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Rollback: Rollbacks are performed manually by the on-call engineer using the deploy CLI.
pairs.new: Rollback: Rollbacks are triggered automatically when the error rate exceeds 2% for 5 consecutive minutes.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Coverage Threshold: The minimum required unit test coverage for merging into main is 70%.
pairs.new: Coverage Threshold: The minimum required unit test coverage for merging into main is 85%.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Backup Schedule: Production database backups run daily at midnight UTC and are retained for 14 days.
pairs.new: Backup Schedule: Production database backups run hourly and are retained for 30 days.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Restore Drills: Restore drills are conducted once per year.
pairs.new: Restore Drills: Restore drills are conducted once per quarter.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Production Credentials: Production database credentials are shared with the platform team via the team password vault.
pairs.new: Production Credentials: Direct sharing of production database credentials is forbidden. Access is granted through short-lived tokens issued by the identity provider.

pairs.label: CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Secret Rotation: Secrets are rotated every 180 days.
pairs.new: Secret Rotation: Secrets are rotated every 90 days.

pairs.label: NO_CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Sick Leave: Sick leave is uncapped and does not require a medical certificate for absences of 3 days or fewer.
pairs.new: Sick Leave: There is no cap on sick leave. A medical certificate is not needed for absences of three days or less.

pairs.label: NO_CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Internet Reimbursement: Northwind reimburses up to $40 per month toward home internet costs for employees working remotely three or more days per week.
pairs.new: Internet Reimbursement: Employees who work remotely at least three days a week may claim up to $40 monthly for home internet.

pairs.label: NO_CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Coverage: This handbook applies to all full-time and part-time employees, including contractors engaged for more than 90 consecutive days.
pairs.new: Customer Data on Personal Devices: Storing customer data on personal devices is prohibited. All work must be performed on company-issued hardware.

pairs.label: NO_CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Core Hours: Employees are expected to be reachable between 11:00 and 16:00 in their local timezone.
pairs.new: Meeting Etiquette: Recurring meetings longer than 30 minutes require a written agenda circulated in advance.

pairs.label: NO_CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Core Hours: Employees are expected to be reachable between 11:00 and 16:00 in their local timezone.
pairs.new: Core Hours: Employees should be contactable during the 11:00-16:00 window in whichever timezone they are based.

pairs.label: NO_CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Coverage: This handbook applies to all employees of Northwind Systems.
pairs.new: Coverage: This handbook applies to all employees of Northwind Systems. Section 6 additionally applies to vendor personnel with system access.

pairs.label: NO_CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Peripherals: Monitors, keyboards and headsets are ordered through the internal IT portal.
pairs.new: Restore Drills: Restore drills are conducted once per quarter.

pairs.label: NO_CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Rollback: Rollbacks are triggered automatically when the error rate exceeds 2% for 5 consecutive minutes.
pairs.new: Rollback: Automatic rollback fires on a sustained error rate above 2%; the on-call engineer is paged at the same time.

pairs.label: NO_CONTRADICTION
pairs.old: Remote Work Eligibility: Engineering and product staff must attend the office a minimum of 3 days per week.
pairs.new: Remote Work Eligibility: Customer support staff follow a fully remote arrangement with no in-office requirement.
